description: Unison Oscillator: up to sixteen detuned saw or pulse oscillators stacked into one voice, with a sub oscillator and the Slop drift built in

params.text: Shifts the pitch in whole octaves, -3 to +3
Tunes the pitch, up to 7 semitones either way
Sets how many oscillators are stacked, 1 to 16
Chooses the wave every stacked copy uses, marked SAW and PULSE
Attenuverts the pulse-width modulation, whether it arrives at the jack or comes from the internal oscillator
Sets the rate of the internal pulse-width modulation, 0.03Hz to 10Hz
Sets how far apart the stacked copies are tuned, up to 50 cents
Spreads the stacked copies across the two outputs, 0 to 100%
Sets how much sub oscillator is added to the outputs
Chooses whether the sub oscillator follows the centre pitch alone or one per stacked copy, marked CENTRE and STACK
Sets how fast the drift moves, from 120 seconds down to half a second
Depth of a 60Hz vibrato shared by every stacked copy, reaching 12 cents peak
Depth of the slow drift shared by every stacked copy, up to 10 cents
Depth of the slow drift each stacked copy receives on its own, up to 10 cents or 1.5Hz
Sets how accurately the stack tracks the input; below full each copy is out by up to 20 cents per octave played
Reads the individual drift as a detuning in cents or as an offset in Hz, marked CENTS and HZ
Attenuverts the stereo width CV input

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the stack, one octave per volt
Sets the pulse width, scaled by the PWM knob; patching it replaces the internal modulation
Shifts the unison spread, scaled by its attenuverter
Shifts the stereo width, scaled by its attenuverter

outputs.text: The whole stack summed to one channel
The left side of the stereo spread
The right side of the stereo spread

notes: with the pulse-width jack unpatched, an internal oscillator moves the pulse width at the rate the RATE knob sets

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the internal modulation oscillator; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.

±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
